title: Every result, with its source and its limits
body: Each card gives the source, scope, sample count, date, configuration and limitations. Where an export exists, its SHA-256 fingerprint is shown, so anyone holding the file can check it is the same one. Empty fields are left visible on purpose. A Measured result without a linked export is flagged until the export is attached.

measured.label: Measured
measured.help: Produced by running our system on stated data, and backed by a dated export.

replay.label: Historical public replay
replay.help: Public historical data replayed for context. Not an observation from the partner farm.

planned.label: Planned
planned.help: The work is defined. No result exists yet.

concept.label: Concept
concept.help: An illustration of a possible future. Not built and not measured.

items.title: GPU recheck on historical-source images
items.scope: Historical source images re-run through the device GPU inference path
items.dateMissing: Add the run date from the export
items.configuration: GPU inference. Model version, preprocessing and thresholds are not yet linked
limitations: This is not independent field accuracy
Exact train/test duplicates were removed, but other dependencies between images are unresolved
Raw classification only: no uncertainty threshold and no human review applied

items.title: TensorRT inference on the Jetson
items.result: Inference runs on the Jetson Orin Nano Super GPU
items.scope: A functional check. Speed and accuracy are not part of this claim
items.dateMissing: Add the date of the run
items.configuration: Jetson Orin Nano Super, TensorRT. Engine and model versions are not yet linked

source.missing: Fresh evidence export not yet attached

limitations: Shows that inference runs, not how well it performs

items.title: Daily weather replay
items.scope: Regional reference area near Oradea. Coordinates are withheld and the area's crop is unknown
items.configuration: NASA POWER daily data. The parameter list is not yet linked
limitations: Modelled, coarse-grid data, not an on-farm station
Not the partner farm's parcel
Does not establish disease risk

items.title: Sentinel-2 monthly replay
items.scope: Same regional reference area near Oradea. The crop identity is unknown
items.configuration: Copernicus Sentinel-2. Cloud screening and index method are not yet documented here
limitations: Monthly cadence misses short events
A vegetation index alone does not establish crop stage or disease risk
Not the partner farm's parcel

items.title: UK/Ireland public image benchmark
items.scope: Public images from the UK and Ireland, prepared separately from training data
items.dateMissing: Shown only once a dated, exported evaluation exists
items.configuration: To be fixed before the evaluation is run
limitations: Pass or fail is not implied
A public benchmark is not field validation

items.title: Pre-registered evaluation protocol
items.result: To be published before any benchmark result
items.scope: Fixes the test data, the group-aware split, the metrics, the uncertainty thresholds and the acceptance criteria in advance, so results cannot be tuned after the fact
items.dateMissing: Publish with a timestamp (for example a Zenodo DOI) before running the UK/Ireland benchmark
items.configuration: Protocol document plus its SHA-256 fingerprint

source.missing: Not yet written; publication needs the owner's approval

limitations: Pre-registration shows the evaluation was fixed in advance; it does not guarantee a good result

items.title: Device health and storage
items.scope: Storage, temperature and service status of the prototype
limitations: A mounted SSD does not prove the storage is healthy
Status can change between exports

items.title: TRL4 lab validation
items.scope: Bounded scouting application: existing Jetson, an identified camera, GPS handling, GPU inference, reviewed observations and reproducible evidence
items.samples: To be defined in the validation protocol
items.configuration: To be frozen in the TRL4 evidence pack
limitations: Required as the starting TRL for eligibility (Annex 1, criterion 14)

items.title: M4, IoT Observatory and Data Cube integration
items.scope: Consume M4 Zadoks-stage and disease-risk outputs. Compare edge, cloud and mixed execution
items.configuration: Interfaces are confirmed during Sprint 1 onboarding
limitations: A leaf classifier or an NDVI view alone does not meet the platform-integration requirements

items.title: Pesticide-use impact
items.scope: Annex 1.1 §10.1 asks for credible field-tested evidence for at least one programme target. For T4 the relevant one is a >40% reduction in pesticide use
items.samples: To be designed with the site partner
limitations: No reduction is claimed
Attribution needs a comparison design agreed before the season

items.title: Field unit, rover, aerial scouts, manipulator
limitations: Not built, not measured, not device output

excluded.title: Figures we deliberately do not show
items: An older training report gives a headline accuracy measured during training. It is not validated field accuracy, so it is not presented as a result.
No live telemetry, invented scores, disease maps or customer logos appear anywhere on this page.
